name: [UPDATE!] STRAFE FPS
desc:
Welcome to STRAFE FPS — a fast-paced arena movement FPS.

Bhop and slide around the map, take fights nonstop, and climb the leaderboard.

🌀 Movement: sliding + bunny hop
⚔️ Modes: TDM, Duels, Free-For-All, Gun Game and more!
🏟️ Multiple maps

👍 Like the game to support development!

⚠️ WARNING:
Any form of cheating, exploiting, or alt account farming will lead to an immediate permanent ban.
